high_level_description: This image captures a striking sunset scene with a vivid orange and red sky dominating the background. The clouds are scattered across the sky, adding texture and depth to the vibrant hues. Below the sky, there is a traffic light pole with three traffic lights, all of which are showing red signals. The traffic lights are silhouetted against the colorful sky, creating a stark contrast. In the foreground, there are silhouettes of trees and foliage, which appear dark due to the low light conditions.
